nodes.product: AI/automotive chip designer - Samsung Foundry contract-manufacturing customer (USD 16.5B, 2025-2033)

edges.relationship: contract manufacturing (foundry) of Tesla AI/automotive chips

contracts.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), order-book table (II.4) and disclosed-contract status (XI.1): DS division Foundry business semiconductor contract-manufacturing supply contract with Tesla, Inc. - signed 07-26-2025, contract period 07-2025 to 12-31-2033, total order value USD 16,544M; the contract period and amount may change with customer demand and business progress; quantities, amounts delivered and remaining backlog omitted as trade secrets. It is the only itemised foundry order in the filing.

edges.relationship: 4nm logic base dies for Samsung HBM4/HBM4E and 4nm SSD controllers (in-house one-stop solution)

contracts.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), R&D detail: HBM4 in mass-production shipment since 02-2026 uses 1c DRAM with a 4nm base die made in Samsung's foundry; HBM4E 12-high samples shipped 05-2026 on the same logic-memory-foundry-packaging one-stop solution; the PCIe 6.0 server SSD PM1763 uses a 4nm controller. The 4nm HPC-dedicated 4th-generation process has been in mass production since 11-2024.
contracts.units: HBM4 base dies (4nm) from 02-2026; HBM4E samples 05-2026
